usage: run_command.py [-h] --cwd CWD --out OUT --label LABEL [--source SOURCE]
                      [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                      ...

Capture an explicit command; no installer, shell, checker inference or
acceptance claim.

positional arguments:
  command

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --cwd CWD
  --out OUT
  --label LABEL
  --source SOURCE
  --timeout TIMEOUT

usage: replay_no_install.py [-h] --project PROJECT --lean-bin LEAN_BIN
                            --out OUT [--timeout TIMEOUT]

Run the standalone files with an ALREADY INSTALLED pinned Lean and prebuilt
dependencies. Reads a prepared project only. Writes fresh command evidence and
objects outside that project. Does not invoke Lake/elan, build dependencies,
download files, install tools or infer a checker.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT    Existing, fully prepared pinned project
  --lean-bin LEAN_BIN  Absolute native bin/lean, NOT an elan shim
  --out OUT            New evidence directory outside project and packet
  --timeout TIMEOUT

usage: verify_packet.py [-h] [--extract-to EXTRACT_TO] [--receipt RECEIPT]
                        archive

Verify a sealed packet ZIP, extract a new copy, and optionally write a
DETACHED receipt. Checks paths, duplicates, CRC, the exact manifest member set
and SHA-256 after extraction. Also records independent system unzip/sha256sum
checks when available. Not a Lean checker.

positional arguments:
  archive

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --extract-to EXTRACT_TO
  --receipt RECEIPT

scope: Python parse and CLI help only; replay Lean path remains unexecuted
